record.context_brief: Affine connections on the normal-distribution statistical Lie group
record.original_question: What is the moduli space of left invariant affine connections on the statistical Lie group of univariate normal distributions that are compatible with the Fisher metric?

evidence.quote: Determine the moduli space of left invariant affine connections on the statistical Lie group of univariate normal distributions compatible to the Fisher metric.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathcal{N}$ denote the family of univariate normal distributions
$$p(x;\mu,\sigma)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}\,\sigma}\exp\!\left(-\frac{(x-\mu)^2}{2\sigma^2}\right),\qquad \mu\in\mathbb{R},\ \sigma>0.$$
Identify $\mathcal{N}$ with the two-dimensional Lie group $G=\{(\mu,\sigma):\sigma>0\}$ whose group operation is
$$(\mu_1,\sigma_1)\cdot(\mu_2,\sigma_2)=(\mu_1+\sigma_1\mu_2,\ \sigma_1\sigma_2),$$
so that $G$ acts on itself by left translations $L_{(a,b)}(\mu,\sigma)=(a+b\mu,\,b\sigma)$. Equip $G$ with the Fisher information metric
$$g=\frac{d\mu\otimes d\mu+2\,d\sigma\otimes d\sigma}{\sigma^{2}},$$
which is left-invariant under the above action.

An affine connection $\nabla$ on $G$ is called left-invariant if $(L_{(a,b)})_{*}\nabla=\nabla$ for every $(a,b)\in G$. Such a connection $\nabla$ is said to be compatible with $g$ (in the statistical sense) if there exists a dual connection $\nabla^{*}$, also an affine connection on $G$, such that for all vector fields $X,Y,Z$ on $G$,
$$X\,g(Y,Z)=g(\nabla_{X}Y,Z)+g(Y,\nabla_{X}^{*}Z),$$
and such that both $\nabla$ and $\nabla^{*}$ are torsion-free.

Let $\mathcal{C}(G,g)$ denote the set of all left-invariant torsion-free affine connections on $G$ that are compatible with $g$ in this sense. The group of $g$-isometric Lie group automorphisms of $G$ acts on $\mathcal{C}(G,g)$ by pullback. 

Determine, with explicit parametrization, the moduli space
$$\mathcal{M}(G,g)=\mathcal{C}(G,g)/\sim,$$
where $\sim$ denotes equivalence under this isometric automorphism action.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem was posed as an open problem at FDIG 2025. A 2025 paper by Furuhata–Inoguchi–Kobayashi establishes that the Amari–Chentsov α-connections are the only left-invariant affine connections on the univariate normal Lie group that are conjugate symmetric with respect to the Fisher metric, and a follow-up preprint (arXiv:2510.04442) studies moduli spaces of left-invariant statistical structures on related Lie groups, focusing on conjugate symmetric and dually flat structures. However, a complete description of the moduli space of all left-invariant Fisher-compatible affine connections on the univariate normal Lie group does not appear to have been carried out, so the problem appears partially solved.

status_evidence.title: The moduli spaces of left-invariant statistical structures on Lie groups
status_evidence.snippet: Studies moduli spaces of left-invariant statistical structures on three families of Lie groups; cites Furuhata–Inoguchi–Kobayashi result that Amari–Chentsov α-connections are the only left-invariant connections on N that are conjugate symmetric w.r.t. the Fisher metric.
status_evidence.claim: Related but does not fully resolve the moduli space for the univariate normal Lie group beyond the conjugate symmetric case.

status_evidence.title: A characterization of the alpha-connections on the statistical manifold of normal distributions
status_evidence.snippet: Characterization of α-connections among left-invariant connections on the normal-distribution Lie group.
status_evidence.claim: Provides a partial classification under the conjugate symmetry condition.
